run_url_filename_recorder: run the script to update TensorFlow Datasets checksums with filenames from URLs
collect_path_to_url_infos: collect all checksums paths and their associated URL info dictionaries for TensorFlow Datasets
request_filename: request the filename for a dataset URL by opening the URL and extracting the filename from the response
update_url_info: update a UrlInfo dataclass with a new filename while preserving existing data
save_url_infos: save updated URL info dictionaries back to their checksums files on disk
